title: Branch protection is applied, not requested
body: Linear history, code owner review and required checks are set by the scaffolder at creation. There is no window in which a new repo is unprotected.

title: Production needs two approvals
body: Environment protection rules live in GitHub, so the gate holds regardless of what a workflow file says. Dev applies straight through.

title: The reviewed plan is the applied plan
body: Terraform plans are posted to the pull request and the same artefact is applied on merge, so what was approved and what ran are the same thing.

title: Tags are set by the platform
body: Owner, cost centre and source repo are written by the baseline module. Showback reporting and the CMDB both key off them, so they are not left to memory.

title: Internal ingress by default
body: Public exposure is an explicit variable a reviewer can see in the diff, rather than something inherited from a copied config.

title: Off-path services stay visible
body: Nothing is blocked from leaving the path. It just shows up in the catalogue with its owner next to it, which turns out to be enough.
